'''2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe THE MACHINE''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech after playing it at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]]. Deck Designs published his final Worlds Dark list as [[2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe DS]]; this posted version differs by a few cards.<ref name="dt-11036">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11036 THE MACHINE], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 10 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11036/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11036/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018111323/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11036/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

The post also lists 1x grabbler, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''THE MACHINE'''
* '''Author:''' Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe
* '''Published:''' October 10, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' this deck is a machine

=== Strategy ===

i have play this deck in day 2, 3-1 lost to Brain Rippetoe because i lost a huge sac war and day 3, 3-0 with the final this deck is the MACHINE and can win against anything....and dont expect me to give strategy because i wont
